description: Which comparability bundles (published transfer rules) are held? Optional receiving institution UNITID, agreement id, or a learning unit that appears as a source or substitute. Answers none held when the build holds none. Each row names its current FORM's wording source: source_url, capture_file, catalog_year and source_catalog_name are that one source's, never the record's whole span. A row whose record holds more than one form or more than one source also carries version_count, source_count, first_edition_seen and last_edition_seen, and one sentence saying so in words; a record with one form and one source carries none of them and reads exactly as it always has. The forms themselves, each with its own content and its own sources, come from the one-record get, never from a list. A record last seen in an older edition says so, because the Union keeps a record no current catalog prints.

agreement_id.description: Optional: the agreement that states it

learning_unit_id.description: Optional: a course named in it

offset.description: Optional: the next_offset from a previous answer

unitid.description: Optional: the receiving institution's IPEDS UNITID
